example.title: Surf shop in a one-storey corner building with a surf mural
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A late-1970s single-storey corner surf shop: a blue-painted block with a big wave-and-surfer mural on the side wall, a flat roof, a long fascia sign board, boards racked outside, a mature ficus shading the sidewalk. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
